Remote visit
Visit more universities remotely to find top talent
Expand your campus hiring reach effortlessly with virtual engagement. Our online platform enables you to connect with universities across geographies, interact with a broader and more diverse pool of students, and identify top tech talent without the need for physical travel. This approach helps you streamline outreach, reduce recruitment costs, and hire the best candidates from anywhere in the world.
Assess
Remote student assessment with secure proctoring
Effortlessly assess students from anywhere with secure, AI-driven online tests that deliver accurate, data-backed insights. With advanced remote proctoring, every assessment remains fair and cheat-proof. This gives you the confidence to identify top talent at scale while maintaining the highest standards of quality and integrity.

Remote student interviews with FaceCode
Remotely interview students with ease using FaceCode, our powerful tech video interview platform designed for seamless collaboration. Invite a panel of hiring managers to join live coding interviews, assess technical and communication skills in real time, and make confident hiring decisions faster.

Efficient Talent Evaluation
Streamline university recruiting with advanced tools
Assess job readiness, prevent plagiarism, eliminate bias, enhance candidate experience, and evaluate coding skills with one seamless platform.
Accurately assess job-readiness in a few minutes
Our university recruiting software lets you simulate an on-the-job coding environment thanks to a library of 25,000+ questions and a dev-friendly user experience.
Prevent plagiarism with advanced proctoring features
With ip-based geofencing and elimination of impersonation, tab-switching and copy-pasting, our university recruiting platform ensures that you evaluate only genuine candidates.
Cut bias out of the screening process with PII Masking
Ensure objective hiring with the ability to hide personally identifiable information from assessments and video interviews on our campus recruitment platform.
Delight candidates with a fantastic user experience
HackerEarth’s campus recruiting software lets candidates code in the programming language of their choice. Further, in-line error highlighting, auto-complete and linting helps developers focus purely on logic rather than syntax.
Evaluate coding skills using FaceCode
Following a coding assessment, our student recruitment software lets you seamlessly set up a live coding interview with candidates on FaceCode, further aiding you to make the right hiring decisions.
Talent solutions for gen-ai era
Single platform to attract, evaluate and engage talent
Attract top talent that fuels innovation. Hire the best with the leading skills assessment platform, measuring both technical expertise and soft skills. Connect with our vast developer community for insights, adoption, and brand impact.
